legacy.title: Legacy Patient Recovery
legacy.lead: Bring the previous system's (Clinica) patients, treatments, clinical tables and files into this clinic, tied to each patient by the old patient id.
legacy.privacy: Everything is processed on this server only. No patient data is sent to any outside service (AI, analytics or other APIs). Files are kept in private storage and open only for signed-in staff allowed to see the record.
legacy.recovery_lead: Every patient of the previous system: what was brought for it and who it is in this clinic.
legacy.legacy_count: {n} old patient files in this clinic
legacy.json_sub: The backup's clinica-patients-….json. It is read as a stream (any size) and is not stored in the database.
legacy.zips_sub: clinica-attachments-NN-of-NN.zip — each with its manifest.json. Add them all; each is checked on its own.
legacy.drop: Drag files here or choose them
legacy.drop_json: Drop the patients .json here or choose it
legacy.drop_zips: Drop the .zip archives here (several at once) or choose them
legacy.remove_confirm: Remove {name} and what was read from it?
legacy.analyzing: Checking the files… this page updates by itself.
legacy.preview_sub: Nothing has been written to the clinic's records yet. Check the numbers, then start.
legacy.match_rule: The key of every patient is the source system + the Clinica patient id (unique in the clinic): the same Clinica patient is never created twice, even if the import runs again. Names are never used to match.
legacy.start_confirm: Create {n} new patients and import their records now? It runs in the background.
legacy.cancel_confirm: Cancel this import and delete its uploaded files?
legacy.need_json: Upload the patients file to see the preview.
legacy.progress_sub: Runs in the background in small steps. If the server restarts it carries on from where it stopped.
legacy.storage_full: The clinic's file storage is full. Raise it — platform admin: Admin → Clinics → this clinic → File storage (a size in MB, or follow the package); one clinic on its own server: CLINIC_STORAGE_MB in .env (empty = no limit) — then press Resume.
legacy.done_ok_sub: Every patient, treatment, clinical row and file of the source is in the system.
legacy.done_issues_sub: The source and the system differ, or some records need attention. See the reconciliation and the error log.

recon.attachment_links: Attachment links → files attached to a patient

legacy.search_ph: Name, mobile, old id or old number
legacy.recover_confirm: Create a patient file from this old file (name and mobile) and attach its records?
legacy.empty_recovery: No old patients yet. They appear here after an import.
legacy.flash_duplicate: {name} was already uploaded (same content); it is ignored.
legacy.flash_linked: The old file is now linked to the patient.
legacy.flash_recovered: The patient file was created from the old file.

err.IMPORT_LOCKED: This import has started; start a new one to add files.
err.IMPORT_NOT_JSON: The patients file must be a .json file.
err.IMPORT_TOO_BIG: The file is larger than allowed.
err.IMPORT_BAD_FILE: The file could not be received.
err.IMPORT_NOT_READY: The files are still being checked.
err.IMPORT_NO_PATIENTS: Upload a valid patients file first.
err.PATIENT_PHONE_TAKEN: Another patient here uses this mobile number; link the old file to that patient instead.
err.PATIENT_INVALID: Choose a patient of this clinic.
err.STORAGE_FULL: The clinic's file storage is full. Raise it — platform admin: Admin → Clinics → this clinic → File storage (a size in MB, or follow the package); one clinic on its own server: CLINIC_STORAGE_MB in .env (empty = no limit) — then press Resume.

ov.other: Other fields of the old file

legacy.no_treatments: No treatments in the old file.
legacy.no_clinical: No clinical tables in the old file.
legacy.mode_initial_sub: This clinic has no patients yet: every Clinica patient becomes a new patient here, keyed by its Clinica patient id.
legacy.mode_reimport_sub: Patients already imported (same Clinica patient id) are not created again; only what is missing is added.
legacy.mode_merge: Import into a clinic with its own patients
legacy.mode_merge_sub: The clinic has {n} patients entered by hand. New Clinica patients are created; duplicates of hand-entered ones are linked or left for review if the check below is on.
legacy.review_missing_id: {n} patient records have no Clinica patient id — they cannot be imported (see the error log).
legacy.review_duplicates: {n} Clinica patient ids appear twice in the file — the first record is used.
legacy.review_ambiguous: {n} patients point at the same hand-entered patient — they are left for you in the recovery list.
legacy.review_orphans: {n} files belong to a patient id that is not in the patients file — they are kept, unattached, in the recovery list.
legacy.review_invalid: {n} files failed validation and will not be imported.
legacy.manual_off: The clinic has {n} patients entered by hand. Checking Clinica patients against them is off: all are created new.
legacy.manual_on: Clinica patients are checked against the clinic's {n} hand-entered patients (old number, file number with name or mobile, mobile with name).
legacy.promote_title: Clinica treatments in the patients' files
legacy.promote_sub: Each Clinica treatment becomes an item of the patient's treatment plan (tooth, treatment, price, done / planned with its date) with its doctor, and the old calendar fills the clinic's calendar: Clinica's appointments, and a visit for each day of treatments. Imported visits are history: not "unpaid" at the cash desk, no messages to patients.
legacy.promote_run: Move everything into the patients' files and the calendar
legacy.promote_progress: {done} of {total} treatments are in the patients' files
legacy.promote_running: Running in the background — it carries on by itself if the server restarts.
legacy.promote_unlinked: {n} belong to patients not linked yet (recovery list)
legacy.promote_started: Started — it runs in the background and carries on by itself.
legacy.promote_pick_doctors: Choose the doctor for names not found and for treatments without a doctor →
legacy.doc_lead: For each doctor name in the Clinica treatments, choose the doctor here (or add a new doctor with that name). Names written in English find the same doctor written in Arabic; spellings of one name are one row. A clinic number written where the doctor goes (Clinic One…) and treatments with no doctor take the patient's doctor of that day, else the patient's usual doctor.
legacy.doc_auto: Same doctor as here (name matched in Arabic / English)
legacy.doc_not_found: Not found here — choose a doctor
legacy.doc_note: Saving applies the choices to the treatment plans and calendar visits made from Clinica (not to what a person changed since).
legacy.doc_saved: Saved — the doctors are being applied in the background.
legacy.purge_sub: To import again cleanly: removes the patients the import created (except any the clinic has added its own records to since), their treatment plans, calendar visits and files from Clinica, the doctors it added that nothing uses, and the import history. Patients that existed before keep their own data.
legacy.purge_confirm: Remove everything that came from Clinica? This cannot be undone.
legacy.purge_started: Removing the imported data in the background — refresh in a minute.
legacy.purge_running: Removing… refresh the page in a minute.
legacy.doc_chair: A clinic chair, not a doctor
legacy.doc_opt_infer: From the patient's visits (doctor of the day / usual doctor)
legacy.grp_lead: The Clinica patient groups become patient groups here. Tie a group to a branch to put the visits of its patients on that branch; otherwise a visit is on its doctor's branch.
legacy.remote_sub: The server signs in to Clinica with your account and pulls: new patients, missing patient details, missing treatments, calendar appointments and attachments — only what is missing: nothing here is cancelled, changed or doubled. Nothing is changed in Clinica.
legacy.remote_privacy: The password is not saved: it stays in the server's memory while the pull runs and is dropped after.
legacy.remote_started: The pull runs in the background — you can close the page.
legacy.remote_stopped: The pull stopped. Press "Carry on" to continue where it was.

remote_wait.NEEDS_SIGN_IN: The server restarted — enter the password again to carry on.
remote_wait.LOGIN_FAILED: Clinica signed us out or refused the sign-in — open the sign-in page again and answer its question.
remote_wait.STORAGE_FULL: The clinic's file storage is full — raise it, then carry on.
remote_wait.STOPPED: The pull is stopped — enter the password and press Carry on.

legacy.remote_question_hint: Type the answer as you would on Clinica's page.
legacy.remote_probe_hint: Signs in and reads the shape of Clinica's pages without patient data; downloads nothing.
legacy.remote_probed: Check done — download the report and send it.
legacy.remote_probe_note: Only the shape of the pages (addresses with numbers replaced, field names, column headers) — no patient name, number or value. The question is answered once: open the sign-in page again for the next sign-in.
